ACME CORP
Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2026
PART I
Item 1. Business

ACME Corp designs, manufactures, and markets rocket-powered devices for the discerning coyote. We operate in two segments: Products and Services.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our business depends on a single customer whose success rate with our products is, to date, zero percent.

We may never sell a product that functions as designed, and our sole customer has announced his intention to pursue alternative suppliers of anvils, catapults, and tunnel paint, any of which could materially reduce our addressable market.

Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Revenue grew despite persistent product returns.
